description: This PHP source file contains functions related to processing query strings in the Revive Adserver project, including converting encoded parameters, generating destination URLs for clicks, and parsing query strings with custom delimiters.

methods.name: MAX_querystringConvertParams
methods.description: Converts a specially encoded query string into $_GET and $_REQUEST globals, handling URL parameters, destinations, and cookies.

methods.name: MAX_querystringGetDestinationUrl
methods.description: Generates the destination URL for a click, appending relevant query parameters from $_GET and $_POST, with fallback options.

methods.name: MAX_querystringParseStr
methods.description: Parses a query string with a specified delimiter into an array, decoding URL-encoded values.
